_error: overlay 'ADJ-2026-032': magnitude -3.0 is less than the minimum 0.0 for
Note that this is a BOUNDS error on the field the author typed, not a
policy error on the composed effect. There is no operator in the registry
with a free-signed magnitude, so a negative magnitude has nowhere to go.
A sign check on the composed effect would have caught this one too, but it
would have caught it at runtime, on an applicant, months later, and it
would have reported the wrong thing.

_expiry_report._note: Spec change scenario 12 and acceptance criterion 9. `decider overlays list --with-age` produces this, and it is the reason `effective_to` and `review_date` are required fields rather than optional ones.

_note: Spec 5.6.2(5) and acceptance criterion 9: the assessment must be runnable
with the stack disabled, THROUGH THE SAME IMPLEMENTATION, because that is
how the statutory calculation's own behaviour is monitored.
That is not a mode and not a flag on the pipeline. It is an empty register:
Every overlay target's `base` value is computed unconditionally and emitted
always, so the disabled run and the live run differ only in which of the two
already-present numbers the caller reads. There is no second code path, and
acceptance criterion 9 is satisfied by construction rather than by a test.
